patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Kaspr and LeadIQ share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Kaspr and LeadIQ share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Kaspr only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo ann” rather than LeadIQ's shape. Choose LeadIQ only if your buying job matches “Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 credits; Pr” rather than Kaspr's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Kaspr is shaped for LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Sta whereas LeadIQ is shaped for Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits —. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Kaspr and LeadIQ share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Kaspr is LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo annual headline.; LeadIQ is Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 credits; Pro from $200/mo..
- Researched limits: Kaspr — LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies; LeadIQ — Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools.

Limitations — Kaspr: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies; Native email outreach/sequencing depth is limited versus engagement platforms; LeadIQ: Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools; Native email sequencing depth is limited versus dedicated engagement platforms.
